svg.text: KnowledgeHub — Multi-Document RAG Assistant with Chat Memory
Architecture draft v1 · 2026-07-27 · bounded-CRAG retrieval over user-uploaded documents · all tiers free unless noted
2 · API — FastAPI on Render (512 MB RAM · 0.1 vCPU · sleeps after 15 min idle)
Injected into every query + payload filter
Typed error envelope · timeout + fallback on every dep
Provider swap is config, never code
3 · INGEST PIPELINE — async worker · progress pushed to client over SSE
4 · QUERY PIPELINE — LangGraph state graph · bounded CRAG · hard cap of one corrective retry
◀ entry: from 2 · POST /chat (user turn + conversation state)
Chunks wrapped in delimited DATA blocks;
delimiter escaped in chunk text so content
cannot break out. Emits inline [n] markers.
corrective retry — hard cap ×1, then abstain
▶ exit: to 1 · SSE token stream — answer streams immediately; G4 verdicts patch citation chips in after
1 GB RAM · 4 GB disk · 0.5 vCPU · single node
Sparse vectors + payload filtering both free-tier
1 GB · expires after 30 days — fine for the assessment window
entity_ledger doubles as the coreference source for Rewrite
Kept in parity with deployed setup — must not drift
Render free spins down at 15 min idle (~60 s cold start)
Sub-15-min ping keeps the demo warm
user_id scopes every Postgres row and Qdrant payload filter
Pre-retrieval scope check. Tuned loose — over-refusal on benign queries is the worse failure.
Refuse before generating if evidence is weak. Doubles as the CRAG grader and abstention trigger.
Ingest sanitation + delimited prompt blocks. Uploaded documents are an untrusted input channel.
Claim-level citation check, run async. G5 · Source pane — user verifies in one click.
All reached through the adapter in band 2. Swapping is an env change.
Flash / Flash-Lite. Primary during development and testing.
Optional final pass before demo recording (~$10 budget).
Alternative final pass. Limits are per-organisation, not per-key.
Roles: routing + rewrite → fastest model · generation → strongest available · judges → off request path
Budget constraint drives two design choices:
1. Conditional rerank — skip when the fused top-1 margin is decisive
Fallback chain: Cohere → cached → fused order (logged, never a hard fail)
512 MB / 0.1 vCPU — rules out bge-base and bge-m3 in-process,
and rules out any local cross-encoder. Rerank must be remote.
Every external dep has a timeout and a named fallback.
Degradation is always logged and surfaced — a fallback must never
be indistinguishable from a healthy path.
